title: DeepSec 2010: All your baseband are belong to us by Ralf Philipp Weinmann
summary: A DeepSec 2010 conference talk by Ralf Philipp Weinmann on attacking the baseband processor of mobile phones rather than the application processor. It covers how open-source GSM base stations make malicious-tower attacks practical against neglected GSM stacks.
why: Cited as the reference for baseband compromise, especially the point that owning the baseband can expose the application processor's memory.

quote.text: Owning the baseband is sufficient to gain access to the raw RAM of the application processor
